name: One-time Desktop Stability R5 fix
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/desktop-stability-r5.yml']
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: nhunnhun-desktop-stability-r5
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  patch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: main
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm install --global pnpm@11.19.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Apply Desktop Stability R5
        run: node maintenance/performance-desktop-stability-r5.mjs
        env:
          BROWSERBASE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_API_KEY }}
          BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID }}
          BROWSERBASE_CONTEXT_ID: ${{ secrets.BROWSERBASE_CONTEXT_ID }}
